Title: Document 5
Content: Source: Joe Cotrill, junior officer, letter to his friend Siegfried Sassoon, `text(1917)`.

No Peace now would be of any use... War is hideous — no one knows it more than you and I — but I'm afraid fighting the swine that we are — that it must go on — in the interests of our own preservation — till we are in a position to make a peace which will give us a certainty of the war not being resumed as soon as Germany thinks she is strong enough.
